full_prompt_en: A square illustrated character study shows a tall, narrow traveler standing in left-facing profile on a nearly blank cream page. He wears a long light brown coat over blue overalls, heavy boots and a dark cap. A small satchel hangs at his hip. One gloved hand is raised toward a red bird perched on his finger, and his long nose tilts up to meet it. At his feet, a thin gray cat sits upright with its tail curling across the ground. Behind the traveler, an ornate circular frame in warm gold contains faint architectural towers and decorative vines. The circle forms a halo-like backdrop but leaves broad empty margins around the main group. Fine ink lines define the coat seams, boots, feathers, cat whiskers and curling ornament. Muted watercolor washes add tan, slate blue, rust red and pale gray, letting the paper remain visible through the color. Light is even and page-like, with minimal cast shadow beneath the boots. The whimsical details are precise but not crowded; the bird's red body is the strongest small accent. The vertical figure and round frame make a balanced emblem, while the cat and loose trailing line anchor the lower edge. The image feels playful and gently old-fashioned, like a character illustration from a carefully drawn storybook.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形角色插画呈现一名瘦高旅者以朝左侧面站在几乎空白的奶油色纸页上。他穿浅棕长外套，里面是蓝工装裤，脚穿厚靴，头戴深帽。小挎包挂在腰侧。一只戴手套的手举向停在指上的红鸟，长鼻也向上靠近。脚边一只细灰猫直坐，尾巴沿地面卷曲。旅者身后暖金色华丽圆框内有淡建筑尖塔和装饰藤纹。圆形像光环背景，却在主组周围留出宽阔空边。细墨线界定外套接缝、靴、羽毛、猫须和卷曲纹饰。柔和水彩洗加入黄褐、板岩蓝、锈红与浅灰，让纸透过颜色可见。光均匀如书页，靴下只有很少投影。奇趣细节准确但不拥挤；红鸟身体是最强小点缀。竖向人物与圆框构成均衡徽章，猫和松散拖线固定下缘。画面俏皮而温和古旧，像一本精心绘制故事书里的角色插图。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration uses fine controlled ink lines, pale translucent washes and generous cream paper. Tan, slate blue, warm gold and rust accents stay muted and carefully placed. A tall narrow form is balanced by a delicate circular ornament, with a few small curling lines near the base. Even page light leaves almost no heavy shadow, so line weight and sparse color carry the depth. Its finish is precise, airy and quietly whimsical.
style_prompt_zh: 这种故事书插画使用细致受控墨线、浅透明色洗和宽裕奶油纸面。黄褐、板岩蓝、暖金与锈色点缀保持柔和且位置谨慎。高窄形体由纤细圆形纹样平衡，基部有少量卷线。均匀纸面光几乎不留厚影，由线重与稀疏颜色承担深度。表面准确、通透且安静奇趣。
theme_en: A whimsical traveler beneath an ornate circle with a bird and cat
theme_zh: 华丽圆框下伴着鸟和猫的奇趣旅者
name: Farel Dalrymple
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
